title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.1.5285
body_markdown:
* Changed chat conversations persistence path from .idea/copilot/chatSessions to ~/.config/github-copilot/IDE\_CODE/chat-sessions/PROJECT\_ID.
* Added ability to select multiple files at once in the chat file reference dialog.
* Fixed an off by one edge case when rendering markdown chat responses.
